name: Shelly EM Gen3 80А
summary: Compact 2-channel single-phase CT energy meter (50A CT incl., 80A option) with 2A contactor relay.

extra.included_ct: CT 50A (family name says 80A; 80A CT is a compatible option per KB)

gotchas: Single voltage reference: measures two CTs on one phase — US split-phase 240V loads need care; see Shelly Pro EM-50 (has split-phase wiring diagram)
Built-in relay is 2A — only for a contactor coil, never the load directly
KB lists CT 50A as included; 80A needs the CT 80A — check what ships before metering >50A circuits
No Ethernet and not DIN-mount — see Shelly Pro EM-50 for panel install with LAN
best_for: Metering a couple of circuits (e.g., heat pump + solar) from inside a panel or junction box
